problem.title: Construct an Optimal Binary Search Tree with Successful and Unsuccessful Search Frequencies
problem.problemStatement: Given sorted keys along with successful and unsuccessful search frequencies, construct the Optimal Binary Search Tree with minimum expected search cost.
problem.input: • The first line contains an integer N. • The second line contains the sorted keys. • The third line contains successful search frequencies. • The fourth line contains unsuccessful search frequencies.
problem.output: • Print the minimum expected search cost and the constructed Optimal BST.
